messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for dedicated pool verdant-eu2-pool (customer: Verdant Analytics). p99 > 1500ms for 6m. Paging @oncall-sre and @eng-runtime. Incident ID INC-2026-54812 
Jess (oncall): ack, I'm on. joining war room. putting paged rotation into the thread. who has customer comms?
Priya (sre): Priya here, taking incident lead for now. first ask: is this scoped to Verdant tenant or multi-tenant?
Ben (infra): initial check: eviction rate up 3x on pool nodes, CPU/GPU utilization 88%, KV cache miss rate jumped from 6% -> 62% after the 02:12 UTC model rollout. traffic origin almost exclusively verdant-analytics api keys.
Diego (eng-runtime): interesting — rollout at 02:12 was llm-giant-v2-q4_0_seq2048. seeing increased memory pressure + cache churn. logs show frequent KV_CACHE_MISS and long tail token gen times.
Maya (support): Alex from Verdant CS on the line, they reported 5-10x latency for sync generations starting ~02:18. They're asking for ETA. Alex (cs): @Maya customer impact: all interactive generation endpoints slowed, several production jobs timed out. They want mitigation now.
Omar (ops): pulling eviction logs and pool routing. Looks like Verdant's tenant weight increased after a traffic surge (batch job) at 02:10. Might be a workload pattern with long sequences.
Priya (sre): immediate mitigations to consider: 1) route Verdant traffic to warm-spare pool in eu-west-1, 2) pin Verdant to llm-giant-v2-std (non-q4) variant, 3) temporary rate-limit/throttle high-concurrency clients. Which is fastest?
Diego (eng-runtime): fastest is rate limit + route override. Model pin requires rollout (but can be done as a direct routing override to a compatible variant). Warm-spare routing needs capacity check.
Ben (infra): capacity: eu-west-1 warm-spare has ~40% spare GPUs, can accept traffic. I'll prepare route for a partial shift (20% -> 50%).
Jess (oncall): do the throttle first. Priya, please approve a 60% reduction in concurrent streams for Verdant until routing is in place.
Priya (sre): approved. Omar, apply rate-limit override: 
```
# apply route override
redwood route override --tenant verdant-analytics --concurrency 40% --until 02:55UTC
```
Omar (ops): done, override applied at 02:29 UTC.
incident-bot: UPDATE: route override applied by Omar at 02:29 UTC. p95 now trending down.
Priya (sre): monitoring... p99 dropped from ~1600ms -> ~720ms within 3 minutes; good signal. Next: start gradual traffic rehoming to eu-west-1 warm-spare. Ben, kick off 20% shift now.
Ben (infra): started 20% routing shift at 02:34 UTC (traffic steering id TS-54812-01).
Diego (eng-runtime): also starting model pin for Verdant via routing table to llm-giant-v2-std (compatibility ok). Rollout set to immediate for Verdant only.
Jess (oncall): status check in 10m. Maya please update Verdant CS: short note that we're throttling and shifting traffic, ETA ~30m for full mitigation.
Maya (support): message sent to Verdant CS 02:37: "We're applying a temporary rate limit and shifting traffic to our warm spare; seeing p99 improvement. We'll confirm when fully stabilized."
Alex (cs): customer acknowledged and asked for a post-incident summary.
Priya (sre): telemetry shows p99 further down to 420ms after 50% shift + model pin. KV cache miss rate is decreasing but still elevated (~18%).
Diego (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: quantized variant (q4) introduced cache behavior causing large KV footprint for long-sequence batched requests; combined with sudden batch job from Verdant caused cache thrash and evictions. Need to validate with trace sampling.
Priya (sre): agreed. action items: 1) short-term: maintain throttles and routing until next deploy window (owner: Jess), 2) medium-term: engineer runbook change to instrument per-tenant KV churn and autoscale signals (owner: Diego), 3) customer comms + RCA (owner: Maya + Alex), 4) postmortem + followups (owner: Priya).
Jess (oncall): Jess handing to Ben for 30m watch and handoff. I'm off for endpoint rotation. Ben please own tactical watch and notify if p99 > 800ms again.
Ben (infra): taking watch. I’ll keep TS-54812-01 open and escalate to oncall if any regression.
Postmortem-bot: NOTE: incident created INC-2026-54812, severity S2. Postmortem owner assigned: Priya. Targeting initial draft within 48h.
Lila (pm): please include customer SLAs and any billing/credits discussion in comms.
Priya (sre): closing warroom for live ops. maintaining throttles and routing until full verification. will open follow-up thread for RCA details. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: RESOLVED: p99 back under SLO for verdant-eu2-pool as of 02:55 UTC after routing and model pin. Monitoring open for 2h. Incident locked for post-incident work.
